patterns.name: Starting from 18:00, record the lowest price and the highest price for the first 4 hours. After that, when the price comes within a range, take a trade in the opposite direction. The range is backtested for the best result. The take profit amount is backtested for the best result as well. It should be one trade per session.
ES 2m, afternoon: a up bar followed by a down bar. Counted 8050 times on the last year of this chart.

Do not measure the size of the move until price moves more than the impulse-tick input inside the impulse-minute input. The script starts at more than 250 ticks in 15 minutes on the 2-minute ES chart. The move must finish within the move-minutes input after that burst. The script starts at 45 minutes. A new extreme after that window is not traded. move_points is how many points the move must be and retest_points is how far from that price the bounce may be. A move up that comes back within retest_points of the high and closes down is a short. A move down that bounces within retest_points of the low and closes up is a buy. After a trade closes, cooldown bars must pass before the next entry. Realized session profit at the daily profit cap, or a realized session loss at the daily loss cap, stops new trades until the next session. The script on file is Large Move Rejection ES.txt. USE that file when the entry already matches. Do not copy it.
